name: rivertide-monorepo
description: Rivertide by Code the Cure: voice-first desktop companion (app), marketing site (website) and shared packages.

scripts.app:reset-onboarding: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('os').homedir()+'/Library/Application Support/Rivertide Dev/data/settings.json';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.log('No settings file yet — onboarding already shows first.');process.exit(0)}const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));j.onboarded=false;fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));console.log('Onboarding reset. Run npm run app:dev.')"
